source_scope: Supplied execution-request archives, not an inferred latest Main/Manual release. Read-only application binding; not a scientific review or source repair.

sections.3.3: Atomic Hamming-1 and composite paths; stochastic weights are a declared downstream choice over admissible events.
sections.3.8: Folded cell-complex proposal requires independent outer closure/certificate; adjacency is insufficient.

interpretation.jitter: Main subsec:fractal-jitter defines unresolved successor movement before seating/return stabilization. A distribution or perturbation law is a new application choice, not derived from that definition.
interpretation.cells: Main supplies finite Q4 vertex/edge support. Explicit oriented cubical filling (16 vertices,32 edges,24 squares,8 cubes,1 four-cell) and a facet-dual transport graph must be declared application constructions under the current user direction.
interpretation.boundary: Main eq:tesseract-admissible-boundary is a retained shell cut in E(Q4) x {-1,0,+1}; application cell boundaries require an explicit dictionary to this support. A cut-frame index is a separate retained observation index, not another spatial axis or automatic SI time.
interpretation.flux_current: Phi^D_boundary(t) is signed one-cut crossing; J^D_boundary(window) is the sum across the declared window. Pair cancellation preserves input histories.
interpretation.afc: Normalized memory/kernel hypotheses are p>=0,sum p=1,P>=0,row sums1. Antisymmetric flux is p_i P_ij-p_j P_ji. Unnormalized injected mass uses a separately declared mass specialization or normalization; no normalized |phi|<=1 claim transfers automatically.
interpretation.accuracy: Exact conservation and boundary-of-boundary zero check implementation/topology. Refinement error against the same model/reference checks numerical accuracy. Jitter sensitivity is a model response. Physical maser accuracy requires independent calibrated dynamics/measurement data.
interpretation.maser_scope: No native maser Hamiltonian, stimulated-emission model, SI-frequency law or hardware observation map is supplied by these source anchors.

recommended_falsifiers: Flip one incidence sign: boundary-of-boundary check must reject.
Drop an internal pair or duplicate a crossing: regional conservation must fail.
Permit negative transition probabilities or an invalid row sum: kernel construction must reject.
Change jitter realization while refining substeps: label this a different experiment rather than a numerical convergence comparison.
Treat total pair cancellation as deletion of parent histories: provenance check must fail.
Claim isotropic flux from an invariant kernel with noninvariant memory: retain the AFC counterexample instead.
